Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class SecurityInfo

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.SecurityInfo
public final class SecurityInfo extends Object
Classifies a URL's connection security for the address-bar indicator and the site-info popup: SecurityInfo.Level.SECURE (https), SecurityInfo.Level.NOT_SECURE (http/ftp), SecurityInfo.Level.LOCAL (file or loopback host), SecurityInfo.Level.INTERNAL (about/data/blob/view-source/javascript) or SecurityInfo.Level.UNKNOWN.

It carries a short summary line and an optional warning, both plain text so the Swing layer can render them without further logic. Free of AWT/JavaFX and built on UrlNormalizer, so it is unit-tested headlessly.
